messages.subject: Issue with googleBubbleChart
parts:
This topic is related to a previous one published in this group (see link: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/shiny-discuss/4GEJZW0ZDUc)

I have a shinyApp with two selectInputs, two googleBubbleCharts and a googleLineChart where each googleBubbleChart is dependent of the corresponding selectInput values and the googleLineChart is dependent of the selected bubbles in the googleBubbleCharts (please see attachment). I agree that the solution posted in the previous link solves the issue when we select a new value in the selectInput components, however both googleBubbleCharts still keep the index of the bubbles selected (input$chart_selection and input$chart1_selection). Therefore, if you click in a new bubble with the same index as the one kept in input$chart_selection or input$chart1_selection, depending on the chart you are clicking on, nothing is triggered and nothing is shown in the lineChart for that bubble. Is there any way to solve this issue?. Can we reset the input$chart_selection value from the shinyApp?.

By the way, why does the observer not work when we unselect one of the bubbles?

Hope my explanation is clear.

Thanks in advance.

messages.subject: Re: Issue with googleBubbleChart
parts:
See below the code in server.R to recreate the googleChart. hash_final is coming from a reactive value. After recreating the googleChart, it still keeps the selection of the previous googlechart so I agree with your comment 1). Can I do this modification by myself or is it a change you will implement?.

output$chart <- reactive({
      hash_final<-data()
      isolate({
      list(
        data = googleDataTable(hash_final),
        options = list(
          title = input$cervecera,
          #series = series(),
          colorAxis = list(colors = c("red", "gray","green"), values=c(0,1000,2000), legend=list(position = 'bottom')),
          hAxis = list(
            title = "Num. tweets",
            viewWindow = list(min=min(hash_final$num_tweets)-1000, max=max(hash_final$num_tweets)+1000)
          ),
          vAxis = list(
            title = "Media sentimiento",
            viewWindow = list(min=min(hash_final$media_sentimiento)-2, max=max(hash_final$media_sentimiento)+2)
          )
        )
      )
      })
  })

What do you mean in comment 2)?. Is it related to when a bubble is unselected (nothing is triggered)?. If not, how can I manage that event?. See below the reactive values I create:

v<-reactiveValues(chart_selection=NULL)
  observeEvent(input$chart_selection,{
    v$chart_selection<-input$chart_selection
  })
  
  observeEvent(data(),{
    v$chart_selection<-NULL
  })
  
  v1<-reactiveValues(chart1_selection=NULL)
  observeEvent(input$chart1_selection,{
    v1$chart1_selection<-input$chart1_selection
  })
  observeEvent(data1(),{
    v1$chart1_selection<-NULL
  })
  
Many thanks for your comments.
